summary: Frontend-only regression run completed for ringtone expansion, chat route stability, and code-review validation of attachment/emoji/voice-note/notification changes. Ringtones screen passed in preview with expanded options visible. Chat route stayed stable and composer dock remained visible, but auth-gated conversation data blocked full interactive validation of attachment sheet, emoji categories in runtime, live voice-note recording, and audible notification behavior.

integration_issues.flow: Attachment sheet and emoji picker runtime interaction
integration_issues.issue: On /chat/testconversation1 preview, conversation resolves to unavailable state, so attachment and emoji triggers are present but disabled for true in-flow interaction checks.

integration_issues.flow: Voice-note start and audible message notification behavior
integration_issues.issue: prepareToRecordAsync + startAsync path and beep+selected-tone playback could only be code-reviewed; native microphone/audio output validation is not feasible in web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking warnings persist in logs (expo-notifications web listener limitation, expo-av deprecation, deprecated shadow/textShadow/pointerEvents props).

action_items: Run signed-in native-device validation for typing-above-keyboard behavior, real voice-note recording start, and audible foreground message alert sequence.
Run authenticated chat conversation regression to verify attachment popup and emoji category row behavior in active conversation state.
Confirm whether background message push sound should also honor selected notification tone (current channel setup in usePushNotifications is fixed to message_notification).
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/frontend/app/chat/[conversationId].tsx` remains very large (>700 lines), which increases regression risk for composer/recording/sheet interactions.
Code review confirms requested voice-note start path is implemented with `prepareToRecordAsync` then `startAsync`.

Code review confirms foreground message hook plays a two-step sequence (beep then selected notification tone), but Android `messages` notification channel in `usePushNotifications` remains hardcoded to `message_notification` for push-level sound.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview checks passed for / and /ringtones, including Classic Ring + Smilers Notification visibility and route stability. Chat route did not crash and composer dock stayed visible, but full validation of attachment/emoji/recording/audio requires authenticated native run with real conversation.
rca_of_issue: Primary blocker is environment-level testability: preview route `/chat/testconversation1` resolves to `chat-unavailable-state`, preventing end-to-end interaction with enabled chat action controls. Audio features (recording + sound playback) require physical device/audio stack for conclusive verification.
